t_title.description: The title used in the HTML <TITLE> tag and the first line of the report.

t_datetime.description: The local date and time when the report was generated.

t_dirs.description: The list of parent directories that was scanned in the report.

t_numdirs.description: The total number of directories and subdirectories scanned.

t_numfiles.description: The total number of MP3 files included in the report.

t_size.description: The total size of all MP3 files included in the report combined.

t_playtime.description: The total playing time of all songs combined.

t_exectime.description: The total time it took to generate the report.

t_avgsize.description: The average size of the MP3s in this report.

t_avgplaytime.description: The average playing time of a single song in the report.

t_filename.description: The filename that the report is being written to.

t_template_filename.description: The filename of the template that is being used.

t_printmode.description: Either 'Yes' or 'No' depending on whether the '--printmode' flag was specified.

t_customdirs.description: Either 'Yes' or 'No' depending on whether user specified custom directories to scan on the command line.

t_genretype.description: Either 'Standard' or 'WinAMP' depending on whether or not the user specified '--stdgenres'.

t_id3v2.description: Either 'Yes' or 'No' depending on whether the '--id3v2' flag was specified.
